frontend-app-ora.instructions.submission.string: Enter your response to the prompt. Your work will save automatically and you can return to complete your response at any time before the due date. After you submit your response, you cannot edit it.

frontend-app-ora.instructions.studentTra.string: Before you begin to assess your peers' responses, you'll learn how to complete peer assessments by reviewing responses that instructors have already assessed. If you select the same options for the response that the instructor selected, you'll move to the next step. If you don't select the same options, you'll review the response and try again.

frontend-app-ora.instructions.peerAssess.string: Read and assess the following response from one of your peers.

frontend-app-ora.instructions.done.string: You have successfully completed this problem and received a {earned}/{possible}.
